:notebook: *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`

This is occurrence **#40** (resurfaced because `occurrences % 10 == 0` — the noise-reduction guardrail for chronic issues).

**Trajectory**: 38 → 40 occurrences in this single backlog-recovery cycle (G2 + G5). first_seen 2026-05-20, now 7 days of chronic fires. `fix_status: needs-ops-decision`.

**Latest signature (G5, 09:29–09:33Z 2026-05-27):**
• 62 method-ui XHR errors in window
• 74% concentration on `back2internationalltd` (46/62)
• 100% on canonical syncwidget `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/.../GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` path
• Monitor 77419271 last_triggered_ts 09:33:11Z = 1s exact-second match to satellite

**Playbook (from KB):**
1. Confirm chronic baseline — ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume in window vs same window 24h ago (delta <20% = chronic)
2. Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath — if dominant paths under microservices.methodlocal.int, it's pool-level
3. **Check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota first** — DNS bursts present here as Ocelot timeouts
4. Decision tree: (a) raise per-route Ocelot timeout, (b) scale/recycle microservices IIS pool, (c) profile upstream microservice
